name: The Hand of God
source:
After doing a favour for a stranger, he tells you the story of the horrible creature known as 'The Hand of God.'

[From [url=https://sonders-stories.itch.io/the-hand-of-god]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你幫了一名陌生人一個忙，隨後，他向你講述了一個故事：關於名為「上帝之手」的可怕生物。

[摘自[url=https://sonders-stories.itch.io/the-hand-of-god]itch.io[/url]]
